historical_comparison_limit: Different dates/source allocations, no paired full control. Descriptive ratio only; the paired runtime evidence is the separately locked development slice.

composition.method: Crossed paired-seed/preparation percentile bootstrap,10000draws,RNG2026; three timing restarts retained within each quality seed. Same method as round five.
composition.scope: Historical round-three prepared target deliveries plus three new complete CPU allocations. Both optimizer arms receive identical preparation cost. This is composed, not a directly measured cold GPU pipeline or a new final optimizer comparison.

conditional_planning_bound.source: Unchanged round-five target critical-path decomposition, with the new measured mean full preparation cost substituted.
conditional_planning_bound.limit: Planning only, holding all historical nontraining costs and target crossings fixed. Not a measured speed result, confidence bound or universal impossibility proof.

clocks.native_main: Setup, preparation, publication and exact full oracle verification after Python imports; worker timers are nested and are not added to wall time.
clocks.python_process: Imports through worker shutdown and final verification. Excludes container startup; each full allocation charges its own startup.
clocks.allocation: Complete parent Slurm elapsed time, including container/source setup and termination; queue wait excluded. Used for cold composition consistently with historical evidence.
clocks.memory: Sampled process-tree PSS/RSS during native main plus workers. Excludes imports/container startup; cache payload accounting is not an RSS bound.

legacy_counter_note: raw_native_calls counts1124native packer invocations, including254first-pass video cache hits. It does not mean1124raw decodes.
cache_scope: 308unique source videos and562independent uncached target replays; observed first-pass hit/miss counts are reported per run, with at most254potential hits. Full hashes, deterministic ordering and native publication remain. No cache flushing; shared Lustre/storage-cache state is not controlled.
limitations: Three sequential runs on one configured CPU node, historically exposed data, no new quality outcomes, no inference-latency or optimizer-specific shared-preparation claim. All failures and search costs remain in the allocation ledger rather than being discarded.
